name: opencode relay
description: New workspace with opencode in `dir`; when it answers the first prompt, send the second.

variables.first: Reply with the word 'ready' in uppercase letters and nothing else.
variables.second: Now reply with the word 'second' in uppercase letters and nothing else.

steps.description: A new workspace in the project directory
opencode in the workspace's first pane, started with the first prompt
Fires when opencode prints the first marker
Second step: type the next prompt and submit it
Fires when opencode prints the second marker
